Sentences from a user study

Biomedical researchers rewrote the conclusions of five PubMed abstracts as AIDA sentences. Each sentence links to its own page.

Table

tables/npuserstudy.csv

The distinct sentences that the participants of the user study wrote for each of the five abstracts. The study is described in Broadening the Scope of Nanopublications (2013).
